normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the transferFrom source argument, so fold it into the transferFrom function node
_to is only meaningful as the transferFrom destination argument, so fold it into the transferFrom function node
_value is only meaningful as the amount processed by transferFrom, so fold it into the transferFrom function node
_spender is only meaningful as the approve target key, so fold it into the approve function node
addedValue is only consumed by the mint arithmetic in _mints, so fold it into the _mints function node
_tos is only consumed by the batchSend distribution loop, so fold it into the batchSend function node
addr is only written to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress, so fold it into the setTradeAddress function node
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init, so fold it into the init function node
